info.title: Risaina API
info.description: Private two-person relationship app. See docs/API.md for the design contract.

emailVerified.description: True once the email was confirmed (6-digit code) or came from Google. Informational only.

hasPassword.description: False for Google-only accounts. Decides DELETE /me confirmation: { password } vs { confirm: "DELETE" }.

shareLocalTime.description: When false the partner sees timeZone: null

shareWeather.description: When false the partner sees city: null

timeZone.description: IANA id; null when unset or the partner turned shareLocalTime off

city.description: null when unset or the partner turned shareWeather off

photoMediaId.description: Set only for PHOTO; fetch with GET /media/:id/url

chatWallpaper.description: Shared chat wallpaper (same for both partners); null = app default

sharedPreferences.description: Flat client keys (string|number|boolean) set with PATCH /couple { sharedPreferences } plus the typed, server-managed chatWallpaper (set with PATCH /couple { chatWallpaper })

viewOnce.description: View-once photo (only the recipient can open it, once)

openedAt.description: When the recipient opened a view-once photo

viewOnceExpired.description: True when a view-once photo was purged unopened (openedAt stays null)

sourceMessageId.description: Chat photo message this memory was auto-created from; null for manual memories

authorId.description: Who set it; the audience is the other member

panic.description: A panic alert: the sender also shares live location

resolvedAt.description: The sender said they are safe now

delivery.description: What the recipient's phone reported when it rang (device state only)

at.description: When the phone took the fix (server clock)

expiresAt.description: null: until the sharer turns it off

lastSeenAt.description: Last check-in from the sharer's phone (liveness)

fix.description: null until the first fix arrives

expiresAt.description: null: until the sharer turns it off

truth.description: Winner: always. Loser: only once they chose truth

dare.description: Winner: always. Loser: only once they chose dare

chosen.description: The loser's blind pick; null until chosen

doneAt.description: Loser marked it done (cleared by a reject)

rejectNote.description: Winner's note on the last reject; cleared by the next complete

xId.description: Plays X this round and moves first (the invitee in round 1)

turnId.description: Whose turn it is; null once the round is over

get.summary: Liveness + dependency status
Readiness (200 when Mongo answers, else 503)

post.summary: Create an account
Sign in with email and password
Sign in (or sign up) with a Google ID token
post.description: Verifies the ID token against Google keys (issuer accounts.google.com, audience in GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS, email_verified must be true). Resolves by Google sub, then by email (linking; an unverified password account loses its password and sessions), else creates an account. Always 200; `isNewUser` tells whether the account was just created.

isNewUser.description: True when this call created the account

post.summary: Confirm the account email with the 6-digit code
post.description: Idempotent once verified. Wrong code: 400 verification_code_invalid (details.attemptsRemaining); the 5th wrong code kills it: 429 verification_attempts_exceeded; expired or none: 410 verification_code_expired.

post.summary: Email a new verification code (1 per 60 s, 5 per hour)
Rotate a refresh token
post.description: Every refresh token is single use. Presenting a token that was already rotated revokes the whole session family, except within 60 s from the same deviceId while the replacement session is still unused (a response lost to a killed app): then a fresh pair is issued and the unused replacement is revoked.

post.summary: Revoke the session (and that device push token)
Request a password reset (always 202)
Reset the password with a token from the reset email

get.summary: Current user, couple, partner and preferences

patch.summary: Update profile: display name, avatar, birthday, time zone, shareLocalTime

anyOf.description: 'YYYY-MM-DD', or '--MM-DD' when the year is private (Feb 29 allowed). Not in the future.

city.description: { name 1–80, latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180 } (rounded to 2 decimals); null clears

delete.summary: Delete the account (cascades: sessions, devices, couple ended and purged, own media deleted)
delete.description: Accounts with a password send { password }. Google-only accounts (user.hasPassword = false) send { confirm: "DELETE" }. Anything else is 401.

password.description: Required when the account has a password (user.hasPassword)

confirm.description: Required instead of password for Google-only accounts (no password)

get.summary: Get preferences
Export my data (bounded to 1000 items per collection)

widgetBoards.description: Both boards of the couple (authorId tells whose)

liveLocation.description: My own live-location session while I share it (never my partner's); no history exists

post.summary: Create an invitation code (shown once); creates a pending couple if none

get.summary: Current open invitation (without the code)

post.summary: Accept an invitation code and activate the couple
post.description: 5 attempts per 15 minutes per user+IP. 410 invitation_expired, 409 invitation_used / already_paired.

code.description: Case-insensitive; separators and confusable letters are normalised

get.summary: Get the active couple and partner

chatWallpaper.description: Shared chat wallpaper for both partners; null resets to the app default

photoMediaId.description: Required for PHOTO (ready photo|wallpaper media of this couple, not view-once); must be omitted/null otherwise

post.summary: End the couple: both members notified, all couple data and media purged
post.description: Hard-deletes everything the couple created (messages, pings, memories, milestones, lists, games, widget boards, SOS, invitations, media objects and documents, avatars uploaded in this couple, and every event except the final couple.unlinked, which the ex-partner can still read for 7 days).

put.summary: Register / refresh this device push token (write-only; never returned)

post.summary: Send a test push to my own phone(s)
post.description: High priority, data-only `{ type: "test.push", eventId, coupleId: "", seq: "0", pr: "h" }`, sent straight to the caller's device tokens (never to the partner, never stored as an event). `scheduled: false` with a reason when push is disabled on the server or no phone is registered. 6 per user per 10 minutes.

deviceId.description: Only this phone (default: every phone of the caller)

delaySeconds.description: Wait before sending, so there is time to lock the phone or close the app

get.summary: Delivery health of my phones and, when paired, my partner's

post.summary: Send a Touch Ping (idempotent; cooldown + hourly cap enforced)

get.summary: Ping history (newest first)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextCursor

post.summary: Recipient acknowledges delivery (idempotent)
Recipient marks the ping as seen (idempotent)
Send a message (idempotent)
post.description: text required for text|emoji; mediaId required for photo|voice and must be ready, owned by the sender and of the matching category. viewOnce: true only for photo (400 otherwise); its media must not already be used by a message, memory or widget board (409 conflict). A non view-once photo also creates a memory (memory.created, sourceMessageId = message id).

viewOnce.description: View-once photo. true is only allowed for type photo (else 400)

get.summary: Message history (newest first; deleted messages are tombstones)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextCursor

post.summary: Recipient marks as read (idempotent)
Recipient opens a view-once photo (once): short-lived download URL
post.description: First call: sets openedAt, emits message.opened { messageId, openedAt } and returns { url, expiresAt, message } (URL TTL VIEW_ONCE_URL_TTL_SECONDS, default 120). Later calls: 410 view_once_consumed. Purged unopened: 410 view_once_expired. Not a view-once photo: 400. Sender: 403. Deleted or other couple: 404.

url.description: Signed GET URL for the photo; valid once-ish for a short TTL

delete.summary: Sender soft-deletes a message (media object deleted; its auto-memory soft-deleted)

post.summary: Create a pending media record and a presigned PUT URL
Verify the uploaded object (HEAD + magic bytes) and mark it ready

get.summary: Short-lived signed download URL (membership-checked)
get.description: View-once media: 403 view_once for both members (use POST /messages/:id/open).

post.summary: Create a memory from a ready photo

get.summary: List memories (newest first)

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextCursor

post.summary: Create a milestone

get.summary: List milestones (by date)
Shared lists of the couple (pinned first, then most recently updated; max 200)

post.summary: Create a note or checklist

items.description: doneBy / doneAt (and id on create) may be sent but are ignored: the server owns them

patch.summary: Update a list (items replaces the whole array; optional expectedVersion)
patch.description: Increments version. When expectedVersion is given and differs from the current version: 409 { error: { code: "version_conflict", details: { list: List } } } with the current list.

id.description: Keep the id the server assigned; unknown ids are treated as new items

items.description: doneBy / doneAt (and id on create) may be sent but are ignored: the server owns them

expectedVersion.description: When given and not the current version: 409 version_conflict

get.summary: Widget boards: mine (what I show my partner) and forMe (what my partner shows me)

mine.description: What I set for my partner

forMe.description: What my partner set for me

put.summary: Set (part of) what my partner's widgets show
put.description: Any subset of { note, emoji, mood, photoMediaId }; omitted fields keep their value, null clears. Emits widget.updated { board } (pushed to the partner). 30 writes per user per minute.

photoMediaId.description: Ready photo|wallpaper media of the same couple, not view-once; null clears. Fetched with GET /media/:id/url

post.summary: Raise an SOS to the partner (always pushed, even in quiet hours)
post.description: At most 3 per sender per 10 minutes (429 rate_limited with Retry-After). A repeat with the same idempotencyKey returns the first SOS (not counted); if that first request stored it but never emitted sos.raised, the repeat emits it. 503 (Retry-After) while another request is emitting it.

panic.description: Panic alert: the sender also starts sharing live location (stored only when true)

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: a repeat with the same key returns the first SOS and emits nothing

get.summary: Recent SOS alerts of the couple (newest first, max 20)

post.summary: Recipient acknowledges an SOS (idempotent)
Recipient's phone confirms the alarm is ringing (idempotent)
post.description: Sets deliveredAt once, emits sos.delivered to the sender and stops the re-pushes. The optional body carries device state (alarm muted, ringer mode, Do Not Disturb), never content.

post.summary: Sender says "I'm safe now" (idempotent)
post.description: Sets resolvedAt, emits sos.resolved once (stops the alarm on the partner's phone) and ends the live location shared for this SOS (location.stopped, reason resolved).

post.summary: Ring a test alarm on my own phones through the server
post.description: Pushes {type: sos.test} after delaySeconds (default 15). 3 per user per 10 minutes. No database write, no event. queued is false when push is off or I have no devices.

delaySeconds.description: Wait before pushing, so the phone can be locked or the app closed first

devices.description: How many of my devices will receive the test

get.summary: Built-in truth and dare ideas (20 each)
The games the picker offers, with their options (trivia categories, decks)
get.description: Trivia questions come from Open Trivia Database (CC BY-SA 4.0): show `trivia.attribution`, linking `trivia.attributionUrl` and `trivia.licenseUrl`.

post.summary: Start a game: rps, tictactoe, trivia or this_or_that (one open game per couple)
post.description: 409 game_in_progress with details.game when an open game exists. Trivia fetches its questions server-side first (up to a few seconds), falling back to a built-in set.

prize.description: 'none' = just for fun, the winner gets no truth or dare. Omit for the default.
'none' = just for fun, the winner gets no truth or dare. Omit for the default.
'none' = just for fun, the winner gets no truth or dare. Omit for the default.

category.description: A curated Open Trivia DB category id; omit for a random curated one

get.summary: Recent games of the couple, newest first (viewer-specific)
One game (viewer-specific: the partner move is hidden until both moved)

post.summary: Play rock, paper, scissors or thread (once per player per round)
post.description: rps only (kept for older apps; /play does the same). Other kinds: 400 "update Risaina".

post.summary: Make a move in any kind of game (a tic-tac-toe cell, a trivia answer, This or That picks)
post.description: The body kind must match the game (400 otherwise). Then 409 invalid_game_state, 409 not_your_turn, 409 invalid_move (taken cell, or a question skipped), 409 already_moved (a retried answer).

item.description: The question being answered; a retried answer gets 409 already_moved, never the next one

picks.description: All picks at once (0 = first choice), one per prompt, in order

post.summary: After a draw: start the next round (either player)
post.description: Tic-tac-toe swaps who plays X (and starts); trivia gets five new questions.

post.summary: After a draw: call it a draw (either player; completed with no winner)
Winner writes BOTH a truth and a dare (status revealed → challenged)
post.description: The loser sees neither text until they choose, then only the chosen one.

post.summary: Loser picks truth or dare blind (status challenged → chosen)

kind.description: Blind pick: the loser has not seen either text

post.summary: Loser marks the chosen truth or dare done (status chosen → awaiting_confirmation)
post.description: A truth needs a non-empty `answer` (400 otherwise); for a dare it is optional.

answer.description: Trimmed, ≤ 500 chars. Required (non-empty) when the loser chose truth; optional for a dare ("" ⇒ null)

post.summary: Winner accepts it (status awaiting_confirmation → completed)
Winner sends it back with an optional note (status awaiting_confirmation → chosen)
post.description: Clears the answer; the note is cleared by the next complete.

note.description: Optional note to the loser, trimmed, ≤ 200 chars ("" ⇒ null)

post.summary: Cancel an unfinished game (either player; idempotent)

get.summary: Events newer than `since` (missed-event recovery)
get.description: Active couple: all its events. After an unlink (and until paired again) the ended couple's `couple.unlinked` event stays readable for 7 days; otherwise 409 not_paired.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Last seq the client has applied

get.summary: Live location: my session and my partner’s (expired sessions are null)

post.summary: Start (201) or extend (200) sharing my live location with my partner
post.description: Emits location.started (no coordinates; pushed to the partner) when the session is new or its reason, expiry or SOS link changed. A stopped sessionId answers 409 location_not_sharing. Manual starts: 20 per user per hour; panic starts have their own 20 per user per 10 minutes. A panic start linked to its SOS is pushed at normal priority (the SOS alarm is the alert).

sosId.description: Panic only: the SOS this sharing belongs to

delete.summary: Stop sharing (always 204; works without a couple)
delete.description: With sessionId: stops only that session (a stale retry never ends a newer one). Without: stops all of mine. Coordinates are removed at once. Emits location.stopped while the couple is active.

put.summary: Upload my latest position (sent to my partner live; never stored as history)
put.description: Overwrites the stored fix when it is newer and always refreshes lastSeenAt. No event, no push. 12 per user per minute.

accepted.description: false: the fix was older than the stored one (the check-in still counts)

put.summary: Upload target for development signed URLs
put.description: Development only. Verifies the HMAC signature and expiry produced by POST /media/uploads.

get.summary: Download endpoint for development signed URLs
